speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These are concerning systemic symptoms; have you noticed any specific changes in your bowel habits or stool color regarding your abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those systemic symptoms—night sweats, significant weight loss, and fatigue—are quite alarming. Have you noticed any blood in your stool, or does your abdomen cause pain specifically when you eat?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The lymph node being described as "fixed" and "enlarged" is highly concerning for malignancy. Have you recently experienced any persistent cough, shortness of breath, or any history of smoking? Also, do you have any known history of liver disease or unexplained fevers?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, LDH, ESR, CRP.
REQUEST TEST: CT_Chest_Abdominal_Pelvis.

Please let me know the answers to your questions so we can proceed.
